label: Today You Will Learn
h: What this course has and has not promised, and which of five faithful responses the present moment actually requires.
body:
About 8 minutes, plus one short pause · one small practice · no homework list

If the help notes in these lessons have spoken to you more than once, the next faithful step may be to contact a doctor or a qualified mental-health professional. That is a good outcome of this course, not a failure of it.

label: Key Scripture
h: "Therefore do not be anxious about tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient for the day is its own trouble."

label: The People in These Pages
h: Grace, unable to switch her mind off. Miriam, waiting fourteen months. Jonathan, with good tools and no life to put them in.
body: Illustrative figures. Nothing about their restlessness was invented.

label: What This Course Has Not Promised
body:
A quiet mindSome find their minds quieter. Others need individual professional care, and that is not a failure of faith.
Fear removed by trustFear is an experience. Trust is a direction. The two can travel together for a long way.
CertaintyNot about tomorrow, the decision, the scan, or whether you were right.
That you should do this aloneThe help notes have been here in every lesson, because for some, this course is a companion to treatment, not a replacement for it.

label: What This Course Has Offered
body:
UnderstandingWhat your mind is doing when it will not rest.
RecognitionThe particular shapes overthinking takes.
RenewalPractices for testing claims and praying without more worry.
A way of livingReceiving peace before the answers, and building a rhythm that holds the rest.

label: The One Pattern Underneath It All
body:
Act

Something is mine to do now.

Wait

Something will be mine, not yet. I will write down when.

Seek help

I lack what I need. I will ask.

Move to safety

Real danger. This comes first.

Surrender

Not mine. I give it to God.

label: The One Sentence
h: Sufficient for the day is its own trouble. Faithfulness does not require carrying every future responsibility at once.

label: Why the Practices Are Small
body:
Six movements, not an attempt to control every prayer. Three columns, not a complete life plan. One small commitment tied to a realistic cue.

The smallness is not because your troubles are small. It is because the present is the only place any of us can respond, and the present is small enough to hold.

label: Do This Now
h: Choose one practice from this course to carry forward. Write where it will live in your week.
body:
One is enough. Then name which of the five responses fits what is actually before you right now.

Pause the audio

label: Remember · Foundation Course Complete
h: You do not have to solve your whole life tonight. Only respond to what is actually before you.

label: A Final Prayer of Surrender
body:
Lord, I cannot solve my whole life tonight,
and I no longer need to.

What is mine to do, I will do.
What must wait, I will let wait.

What I lack, I will ask for.
What is not mine, I release to you.

Not my will, but yours. Amen.
